facts.fact: Internet access in Lac province has been cut since 28 October 2024, still off at the Internet Society Chad communique of 11 February 2025, with security reasons mentioned as possible; the source does not name who ordered it or give an end date.
Internet Society Chad, a civil-society chapter, publicly called on the authorities in a communique of 11 February 2025 to restore access in Lac province and said alternatives to a total cut exist.
facts.system: Cut of internet access in Lac province
